formula: For u orthogonal to columns(A),At=A+tuvT;G=ATA+lambdaI,g=G^-1 v,a=vTg,B=ATC,d=uTC. Recovered At(AtTAt+lambdaI)^-1AtTC = A G^-1B -t²/(1+t²a)Ag gTB +t/(1+t²a)Ag d +t/(1+t²a)u gTB +t²a/(1+t²a)u d. Ridge projector operator norm<=1,so recovered-head Frobenius norm<=anchor norm independent of t. Quantized point is approximate rank-one/normal,errors are reported;this is not a universal classification recovery theorem.
